CustomField.description: Phone number used to verbally verify the wiring instructions - independently looked up, NEVER taken from the email that carried the instructions, which is the entire point of the control. Migrated from Task.Verification_Phone__c, which is Text(40); typed as Phone here for formatting consistency with Wire__c.Verifier_Phone__c. Phone is stored as text, so the migration is a straight copy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number you dialled to verify, looked up independently. Never use a number supplied in the wire instruction email.
